high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "nikitabier," who posted it 7 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The photo captures a stunning coastal scene at what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues in the sky transitioning from yellow to blue. Setting: The location is Vernazza, one of the five villages that make up the Cinque Terre region in Italy. The image showcases a picturesque view of the village perched on a cliff overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. The sky is clear with a gradient of colors
